title: Witherstorm's commands
description: this mod adds commands to minecraft
body:
This is a mod that adds more commands!

commands list:

explode - makes you explode

cat - summons a cat (i just like cats)

wither_storm - summons the witherstorm (requires crackers witherstorm mod and you can now choose the phase it spawns at by typing "/wither_storm spawn phase2" will spawn a wither storm on phase 2)

diamonds - gives the target player/s a stack of diamonds

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

i hope you enjoy!
